correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed all four stationary Bloch coefficient equations from the invariant Pauli-string subspace and solved for u,v,s,t with positive denominator. YI, ZI, XY, XZ anticommute pairwise, yielding doubled spectrum (1±k)/4 and 1−k²=Ω1²(r²+Ω2²)/Δ>0. Faithful stationarity plus Lindblad carré-du-champ forces fixed adjoint observables to commute with both first-qubit reset matrix units, hence I⊗C; nonzero J and Ω2 force C scalar, proving uniqueness in the entire 4x4 state space. Spectral projectors of B=(sY+tZ)/m give a positive product-state decomposition, so separability and zero discord measuring the second spin; the nonparallel first-spin Bloch and X correlation axes exclude a first-side rank-one dephasing and give positive first-side discord. Independent full 16x16 generator computations for two nondegenerate parameter sets found rank 15 and verified stationary formula/spectrum. Analytic proof covers all real nonzero J, Ω1, Ω2, r>0.
